Exam Date & Time: 02-May-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  Applied Cryptography [CSE-3231]  
Marks: 50                                                                          Duration: 180 mins.  
  Descriptive  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Consider the definition of the expression a mod n also makes perfect sense if n is  
  negative. Determine the following:  
  a. 7 mod 4  
  A)      b. 7 mod -4                                                                            (5)  
  c. -7 mod 4  
  d. -7 mod -4  
  
  B)      Solvay-Strassen Primality Testing can be slightly more complex and has more error  
  probability than the computations in Miller-Rabin. Justify with an illustration of     (5)  
  $$n=561$$  
  
2)           Consider p=37, q=43 and d=71 in RSA cryptosystem. Perform encryption &  
  decryption for a message "CY"  
  (5)  
  A)  
  $$B)      Compute C1 and C2 using ECC, for the curve y2=x3+2x+2 over Z17 for the point$$  
  $$(5,1) with d=6 and k=2.                                                                (5)$$  
  
3)           Consider the ElGamal cryptosystem with the following parameters: Prime modulus  
  $$p=29, Primitive root g=2 and Private key a=7$$  
  
  A)      i.Encrypt the message m=15 using the ElGamal cryptosystem with the recipient's  
  $$public key A=12.                                                                       (5)$$  
  $$ii.Decrypt the ciphertext (c1,c2)=(3,23) using the private key a=7$$  
  iii.Discuss the security implications of using the ElGamal cryptosystem with small  
  $$prime modulus p=29.$$  
  
  B)      Compare and contrast the security implications of using SHA-1 versus SHA-256 in  
  modern cryptographic applications.                                                     (5)  
  
4)           Alice, a software developer, wants to securely send a critical piece of code to her  
  colleague Bob. To ensure Bob knows the code originated from her and hasn't been  
  tampered with during transmission, Alice decides to use the Elgamal digital signature  
  A)      scheme for transmitting a hash message 14. Considering prime number p=19 with         (5)  
  primitive root g=10, and Alice's chooses his private key as 16 and Verify whether  
  message reaches safely to bob.  
  
  B)      Consider a simplified key exchange algorithm with p=29 and g=3, where three  
  parties (Alice, Bob, and Carol) choose private keys as follows: Alice's private key a=  
  7, Bob's private key b = 15, Carol's private key c = 11. An attacker receives the      (5)  
  computed public key from Carol and he will send modified key to Alice and Bob as  
  5. Compute the shared key between them and also attacked keys.

5)              A user at a marketing agency, "BuzzBrand," clicks on a suspicious link in a phishing  
  email. The user's computer becomes sluggish, and unexpected pop-up ads start  
  appearing.  
  A)  
  i.What type of malware is most likely infecting the user's computer, based on the  
  symptoms?                                                                              (5)  
  ii.What information can be gathered from system logs and process monitoring to  
  identify the specific malware?  
  iii.How can antivirus software help detect and prevent malware infections?  
  iv.Describe the steps the IT team should take to respond to this malware infection  
  
  B)         A company manages a network of point-of-sale (POS) terminals that process daily  
  credit card transactions. Security is paramount to protect customer data and prevent  
  financial losses. Analyse which type of IDS is most suitable for this scenario and     (5)  
  Justify.  
  
  
-----End-----
